prs.title: feat(web+server): file browser modal navigation & view enhancements
prs.body:
参考 [dsh-workspace-explorer](https://github.com/tm5452/dsh-workspace-explorer) 的交互能力，为 cc-viewer 的 FileBrowserModal 完成「导航与视图增强」三个阶段。

## 交付功能

### P1: 前进/后退历史 + 地址栏
- Alt+←/→、Cmd/Ctrl+[/] 快捷键，工具栏 ◀ ▶ 按钮
- 双击面包屑空白 / Ctrl/Cmd+L 进入地址栏编辑
- 支持相对路径（目录探测→文件定位+预览）和绝对路径（服务端 realpath + containment 校验）

### P2: 列表/网格视图切换 + 服务端排序
- 网格/列表切换按钮，每目录 prefs（sessionStorage）记忆视图和排序
- 服务端 `/api/files` 和 `/api/target-files` 加 `?sort=name|size|mtime&order=asc|desc` 和 `size`/`mtimeMs` 字段（不传保持现有行为向后兼容）
- 列表视图列头可点击排序

### P3: 当前目录文件名过滤
- 工具栏输入框即时过滤
- 纯前端 `matchesFilter` + `splitMatch` 高亮
- 导航时清空、排序/刷新保留

## 服务端改动

- `/api/files` 和 `/api/target-files`: 新增 `size`/`mtimeMs` 字段 + `?sort=&order=` 参数
- `/api/resolve-path` 和 `/api/target-resolve-path`: 新增 `absolutePath` 分支（admin + same-origin 门禁，realpath + containment 校验）

## UI 细节

- 上一级按钮用 corner-left-up L 形图标，挪到工具栏最左
- 刷新按钮统一改用 `ReloadOutlined`（与其他弹窗一致）
- antd Modal header `marginBottom: 0` 修复 treePane border-right 与 header borderBottom 连接
- body `borderRadius: '0 0 8px 8px'` 修复 treePane/gridPane 直角溢出 modal-content 圆角

## Code Review 修复（5 人 review team）

- **安全**: `/api/resolve-path` absolutePath 加 admin + same-origin 门禁
- **OS 兼容**: macOS APFS 大小写用 `realpathSync.native`
- **正确性**: historyStateRef 用 commitHistory 统一同步、项目模式 in-flight 请求加 requestScope 守卫、地址栏 fresh fetch + notFound 提示
- **数据一致性**: name desc 时目录也反序、fileBrowserPrefs `__proto__` 用 Object.create(null)、dirCacheKey 用 NUL 分隔符
- **错误处理**: 地址栏第三个 catch 补 reportSwallowed
- **测试质量**: formatMtime 字面量期望 + 边界用例、prefs `__proto__` 用例

## 验证

- ✅ verify:boundaries (527 files, 0 violations)
- ✅ test:web (5261 pass / 0 fail)
- ✅ test:cli (13377 pass / 0 fail)
- ✅ build
- ✅ verify:tarball-drift (1613 files match baseline)

## Changeset

`.changeset/file-browser-modal-nav-views.md` 声明 `"cc-viewer": patch`（符合只升第三位的规则）。

prs.title: fix(server): preserve ACCESS_TOKEN across self-update restart
prs.body:
## 问题
版本自更新（"立即重启并更新"）后，界面卡在"正在重启，等待新版本恢复…"，手动刷新后 502。

**根因**：`ACCESS_TOKEN` 是 `server.js` 模块级 `randomBytes(16)`，每次进程启动重新生成，且无持久化机制。自更新重启 = 旧进程退出 → helper `npm install -g` → 新进程启动，新进程 token 全新。已打开页面的 `?token=` URL、`/api/version-info` 恢复轮询、`ccv_auth` cookie 在新进程全部被拒 → 轮询卡住、刷新 401/502。

## 方案
自更新重启时把当前 `ACCESS_TOKEN` 经现有重启交接管道传给新进程：
- `cli.js` 两处 restart handler 传 `accessToken: serverMod.getAccessToken()`；
- `launchRestart` 校验后写入 `restart-config.json`(0600)；
- helper 读入内存即删该文件（失败记日志），`restartFromHelper` 注入 `CCV_ACCESS_TOKEN` env;
- 新进程 `server.js` 启动时 `takeInheritedAccessToken()` 读即删、严格 32-hex 校验、缺失/非法回退随机。

仅跨自更新重启保留，不写 `preferences.json`，手动重启仍轮换。新进程对旧页面而言 token 不变，轮询恢复后无感 reload。

## 改动
- 新增 `lib/access-token.js`（契约：env 名 / `isValidAccessToken` / `takeInheritedAccessToken`)
- `server.js` / `lib/restart.js` / `lib/restart-helper.js` / `cli.js` / `lib/auth.js`(注释)
- 测试：新增 `access-token.test.js`、`server-access-token-env.test.js`，扩展 `restart-helper.test.js`、`cli.test.js`（源码契约守卫）

## 验证
- `pnpm run build` ✓ / `verify:boundaries` 0 违规 ✓ / `verify:tarball-drift` ✓
- 相关测试 **91/91 通过**(access-token / restart-helper / server-access-token-env / cli / update-job / update-routes)
- 经 5 角色 cross-review（正确性/安全/兼容/测试/规范），修复了 2 个 HIGH（测试真空断言）+ P1/P2 测试加固 + 安全/文档项

## 已知限制（已写入 CHANGELOG）
- 装本特性的那次更新由旧代码编排，token 保留从**第二次**自更新起生效。
- env 方式下 token 在新进程 exec 环境块中对同用户进程可见；同用户本有 loopback 全权，不越权。token 跨多次自更新有效直至手动重启。

prs.title: fix(server): same-cwd SDK twin [对话] panel no longer cross-talks during the bound-view hydration window
prs.body:
## What
A bound-project client's `/ws/terminal` connection stamps `_ccvViewInstance` from `?instance=`, which is empty until the header's first `/api/live-processes` poll hydrates `boundInstance`. During that cold-mount window the broadcast filter's "exclude only the differently-stamped" rule delivered BOTH same-cwd twins' control frames (modal/queue/spinner/system rows) to the bound view.

## Fix
The bound identity is a deterministic function of the cwd, so the server now coheres the stamp at connect/attach time to the bound cwd's primary instanceKey (`_cohereAttachInstance`, applied at the initial upgrade and all three attach re-stamp sites) instead of waiting for the client to hydrate.

**Narrowing-only:** explicit instanceKey never overridden, non-bound project untouched, PTY mode gated out, single-instance cwd resolves to its only session.

- Adds `sdk-manager.resolveBoundPrimaryInstanceKey` (deterministic-boot-first, NOT the active sibling) as the single source of truth — `resume.js` `currentInstanceKey` now delegates to it.
- Registered from `cli.js` via `setSdkResolveBoundPrimaryInstanceKey`.

## Scope note
This fixes the WS live-push (control-frame) path. The SSE cold-load/history plane (bound view locking primary) is tracked as a follow-up.

## Tests
`ws-instance-isolation.test.js` (resolver + cohere gating + cohered-stamp narrowing), `sdk-multi-session-route.test.js` (`currentInstanceKey` delegation). Full `test:cli` green.

feat(web+server): file browser modal navigation & view enhancements (#177)

Add back/forward history (Alt+←/→, Cmd/Ctrl+[/]), address bar (double-click
breadcrumb blank area or Ctrl/Cmd+L; supports relative and absolute paths,
file paths locate and preview), list/grid view toggle with per-directory

current-folder filename filter with inline highlighting.

  ?sort=name|size|mtime&order=asc|desc parameters (backward compatible —
  omitted params preserve the historical name/asc behavior).
- /api/resolve-path and /api/target-resolve-path: add absolutePath branch
  (admin + same-origin gate, realpath + containment validation).

- Up button uses corner-left-up L-shape icon, moved to the leftmost slot.
- Refresh button unified to ReloadOutlined (matching other modals).
- antd Modal header marginBottom: 0 so the tree pane's border-right and
  the header's borderBottom meet precisely.
- body borderRadius '0 0 8px 8px' so square corners don't overflow the
  outer modal-content rounded corners.

Code review fixes (from 5-reviewer team):
- Address bar third catch now reports via reportSwallowed.
- /api/resolve-path absolutePath branch gates admin + same-origin (was a
  host-filesystem existence oracle).
- macOS case-insensitive FS: use realpathSync.native so containment
  checks accept legitimately-cased in-root paths.
- name desc now reverses directory order too (matching file managers).
- historyStateRef synchronized via commitHistory helper everywhere.
- Project-mode in-flight requests guarded against view-scope switches.
- Address-bar file locate uses fresh fetch and reports notFound on miss.
- fileBrowserPrefs uses Object.create(null) so '__proto__' directories work.

* fix(server): preserve ACCESS_TOKEN across self-update restart

Hand the current LAN ACCESS_TOKEN to the replacement process via the

already-open page's ?token= URL, /api/version-info recovery poll, and
ccv_auth cookie keep working across an in-app update instead of 401/502.

strips the env key at module load, and falls back to a fresh random token
otherwise. The restart helper erases the config the moment it is read into
memory. Token is never persisted; still rotates on a manual restart.

commits.subject: feat(web): persist SDK active-agents panel across browser refresh
commits.message:
feat(web): persist SDK active-agents panel across browser refresh

Persist the SDK-mode active-agents (subAgent/teammate) panel to localStorage
keyed by sessionId (LRU cap 10, TTL 24h) and restore it seed-only on refresh,
reconciling with the authoritative server snapshot.

- restoreFromStorage seeds the panel; an empty same-session snapshot keeps the
  restored rows instead of blanking the panel (refresh-survival semantics)
- seed publishes skip persistence to avoid an empty-snapshot echo destroying
  the checkpoint the next refresh needs
- boot first-activation preserves the tracker (no longer treated as a view
  switch), fixing the replay-then-reset ordering that wiped the restored panel
- close the sdkMode hydration window: gate the boot hook-path clearTaskStore /
  empty SSE task_update on the tracker's actual state (hasSdkState) instead of
  the async sdkMode flag, and let a sdkMode-flip re-restore republish a retained
  unverified seed, so the panel is not blanked while /api/cli-mode is in flight
- _cancelPersist cancels the debounced write on clear/reset so a trailing
  persist cannot resurrect a just-deleted checkpoint
- remove dead mount-time restore call and unused clearAllPersistedSnapshots
- ActiveAgentsBar chevron sizing; slow-upstream-replay test race hardening

Coverage: sdkTaskTracker-persist.test.js, chat-active-agents-wiring.test.js

Also backfill history.md version attribution (1.9.25-1.9.33) for entries that
were left under Unreleased by past releases.

commits.subject: feat(web): "New Workspace (Session)" on a folder + same-cwd twin hardening
commits.message:
feat(web): "New Workspace (Session)" on a folder + same-cwd twin hardening

Right-clicking a folder in the file explorer (sidebar + FileBrowserModal) offers
"New Workspace (Session)": it launches a fresh session rooted there — no -c —
with the picker semantics for other folders (reuse-or-spawn, -c iff logs exist).
On the CURRENT project root it spawns a same-cwd twin instance; Electron opens a
second tab, web/CLI pins the view to the new instance. The file browser modal
closes after a successful launch.

Same-cwd twin hardening (review + write-side isolation): the launch surface is
validated and the new instance's view switches to its EMPTY session (not the old
twin's), with the write side routing each twin's log by instance so the two
concurrent sessions never interleave.

Squashes: 267c7207, a0a4d155, 66bbb00d, 2a65efbb (current-root fresh instance),
5cc38f04, 789e19d7, 2ebdd190 (menu entry + modal + close-on-launch).

commits.subject: feat(server): SDK mode — same-cwd "New Workspace (Session)" is a sibling (workspace +1), not a replace
commits.message:
feat(server): SDK mode — same-cwd "New Workspace (Session)" is a sibling (workspace +1), not a replace

Re-key the SDK session registry from cwd to instanceKey so one cwd can host
several concurrent sessions. A forceNew launch appends a fresh random-key
sibling (createSdkSession) and keeps the existing session(s) alive; the two
surface as switchable header tabs. A plain launch resolves the cwd's primary
(active → deterministic boot → latest) instead of spawning a sibling.

Safety/isolation: resume twin-ownership guard now sees SDK liveness, tracks each
conversation's active owner (in-memory uuid→instance + the SDK session's own
generation-scoped sessionId), resolves a sole-live bare caller, refuses
ambiguous/other-owned resumes (409), and reserves an in-flight uuid against
concurrent double-resume. Close retires a random fresh key / releases a
deterministic key (releaseInstance) and no longer reaps a surviving same-cwd
sibling's scope/scratch. The +1 launch skips the project-level writer reset
(preserveLiveTwin, gated on exact cwd) and tags workspace_started sibling:true
with no global empty reload. An ambiguous same-cwd action anchor (send/Stop)
falls back to the cwd primary.

Coverage: sdk-multi-session-route.test.js (new), sdk-force-new.test.js
(rewritten), resume-route.test.js (+ guard tri-state), v2-retire-instance.test.js
(+ releaseInstance).
